import pandas as pd

def _probe(x, name):

        v = pd.Timedelta(1, "ns")

        for freq in freqs:
            other = np.array(["4940-01-01"], dtype=f"M8[{freq}]")
            td = pd.Timedelta(1, "ns")
            if name == "td + other":
                res = td + other
            elif name == "other - td":
                res = other - td
            else:
                res = None
            probe("td = Timedelta(1, \"ns\"); other = np.array([\"4940-01-01\"], dtype=f\"M8[{freq}]\")  (freq in Y/M); td + other; other - td", res)
    except Exception as e:
        probe_exception("td = Timedelta(1, \"ns\"); other = np.array([\"4940-01-01\"], dtype=f\"M8[{freq}]\")  (freq in Y/M); td + other; other - td", e)

try:
    td = pd.Timedelta(1, "ns")

    # compute both operations for each freq, then combine into a tuple so we still record exactly one value

        results.append(td + other)
        results.append(other - td)
    probe(record_name, results)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception(record_name, e)
